title: micheldev.com projects, archive and links
description: Drives the /projects section, the open-source archive table, and /elsewhere.

since.description: Year of the first public repository. Read only by the `oss_years` metric, so the tile rolls over on 1 January rather than going quietly stale.

stats.description: What /stats.json counts at runtime. Emitted to dist/.stats-sources.json by the build, because the runtime image ships no YAML parser.

npm_since.description: First year to walk npm's history from. Its range endpoint caps a query at 18 months, so lifetime totals are summed a year at a time.

downloads_floor.description: What the downloads tile shows until the live figure arrives, and for readers without JS. Round it DOWN from a measured total so the page can only understate.

metrics.description: The four headline numbers on the homepage hero. Each must trace to something on this page. Give either a literal `value` or a `derive` key, never both — anything countable from content/ should be derived so it cannot go stale. The CV masthead has its own set, in cv.yaml.

derive.description: Counted at render time. stars: summed over archive.repos. repos: archive.total_repos. live_services: live entries, counting subdomains. oss_years: this year minus `since`. downloads: stats.downloads_floor. stars, repos and downloads are then replaced in the browser with the live figures from /stats.json.

url.description: Where the row links. A live service should point at the service, not the repo.

live.description: Deployed and reachable. Grants the green live dot, which must not be claimed otherwise.

tags.description: The first tag is painted in the section hue.

host.description: Bare label only — the apex is added when rendering.

what.description: What this endpoint tracks, in two or three words. Printed at the end of its row, so anything longer wraps the host.

subdomains.description: One entry per running service, listed on the lead plate. Must match the subdomains actually mapped in Terraform.

total_repos.description: Total public repos, for the 'N of M' footer.

what.description: Quote this if it contains a comma — see the note in projects.yaml.

host.description: Displayed under the name — the bare host and path, no scheme.
